About this project

Marvel is a commercial vehicle graphics project: decals and lettering on an SUV for a trading company. Decals and lettering put the essentials — company name, logo, phone number and website — on the SUV in cut or printed vinyl. It is the most affordable way to brand a work vehicle (lettering is typically about 22% of the price of a full wrap) and it is easy to update when your details change.

For trading and distribution businesses the SUV is on the road across the GTA every day, which makes it one of the most cost-effective advertising spaces the company owns. Commercial projects like this one follow the same steps at our shop: we map door handles, seams and body lines on a template of the SUV so text never lands on a gap, send a proof for approval, print and laminate in-house, then install panel by panel in our climate-controlled bay at 50 Viceroy Rd in Vaughan. Installs are backed by our 5-year workmanship warranty against lifting and peeling.

Planning something similar? See commercial vehicle wraps, get a price range with the wrap cost estimator, read about vehicle lettering and decals or learn more about vehicle wraps in Vaughan.
